scripts.snippets: NODE_PATH=../frontend/node_modules esbuild build/snippets.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --loader:.webp=file --loader:.png=file --loader:.svg=file --asset-names=img/[name]-[hash] --public-path=assets --outfile=build/.out/snippets.cjs --log-level=warning && mkdir -p assets/img && cp build/.out/img/* assets/img/ && node build/.out/snippets.cjs
scripts.build: npm run data && npm run snippets && npm run app-css && npm run story
scripts.vo: python3 build/vo.py && python3 build/vo.py --anchors && python3 build/sync-cues.py && node build/cues.mjs
